expected_diagnosis: Backup-related I/O contention coincides with slowness.
recommended_next_checks: Compare multiple days, job schedule, app response metrics.
resolution_guidance: Coordinate scheduling/throttling with backup team; no blind disable.
verification: During backup window performance stays within expected range.
escalate_when: Host storage bandwidth or backup policy.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
